Vercel CLI 59.25.0 (Node.js 22.17.0)

  ▲ vercel blob command [options]

  Interact with Vercel Blob                                                     

  Commands:

  list                                        List all files in the Blob store  
  put           pathToFile                    Upload a file to the Blob store   
  put-image     pathToFileOrUrl               Optimize an image with Vercel     
                                              Image Optimization and store the  
                                              result in the Blob store (requires
                                              OIDC credentials)                 
  get           urlOrPathname                 Download a blob by URL or pathname
  del           urlsOrPathnames               Delete a file from the Blob store 
  copy          fromUrlOrPathname toPathname  Copy a file in the Blob store     
  signed-token                                Issue a short-lived signed token  
                                              for Blob operations               
  presign       pathname                      Generate a presigned URL for Blob 
                                              operations                        
  create-store  [name]                        Create a new Blob store           
  delete-store  [storeId]                     Delete a Blob store               
  get-store     [storeId]                     Get a Blob store                  
  list-stores                                 List all Blob stores              
  empty-store                                 Delete all blobs in a Blob store  


  Options:

   --oidc-token <String>  OIDC token for the Blob store (must be passed together 
                          with --store-id)                                       
   --rw-token <String>    Read_Write_Token for the Blob store                    
   --store-id <String>    Blob store id, with or without the "store_" prefix     
                          (must be passed together with --oidc-token)            


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default off)                          
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default off)                       
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts; when an agent is 
                              detected this is the default                      
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number
